input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The only MFN mechanic in the Agreement runs in our favour: in § 6 TrueLink commits that Hosting Services rates will not exceed those charged to any other party (plus a one-year price freeze). We reviewed the compensation terms (§ 5, § 6), the licence grant (§ 2), and Client's covenants (§ 8), and searched for "no less favorable", most-favoured, right-to-match and comparable-terms language: there is no obligation on Client to extend TrueLink terms given to other hosts or partners, and no obligation to match third-party offers. This meets the preferred position (no Customer MFN obligation benefiting Vendor), so no redline is proposed; the Vendor-granted MFN should be preserved.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
